SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF DEC-19-2018 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF DEC-19-2018 BY CHRISTINE VAN AKEN. PLAINTIFF NEAL STRIKBERGER IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT VERIZON WIRELESS IS PRESENT REPRESENTED BY TRACY GOSSETT EXCUTIVE RELATIONS SR. ANALYST. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: CHRISTINE VAN AKEN; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN; NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF DEC-19-2018 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF STRIKBERGER, NEAL RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT VERIZON WIRELESS $200.00 PRINCIPAL, $155.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $355.00, DEFENDANT TESTIFIED THAT SHORT BATTERY LIFE IS A COVERED DEFECT UNDER THE EXTENDED WARRANTY. IN LIGHT OF THAT TESTIMONY, PLAINTIFF WAS ENTITLED TO A REPLACEMENT IPHONE 6 WITHOUT THE DEFECT. PLAINTIFF'S PURCHASE OF A REPLACEMENT 6S WITH NEW BATTERY GIVES GUIDANCE TO THE COURT ABOUT THE COST OF A REPLACEMENT IPHONE 6 BUT I DISCOUNT THE COST TO ACCOUNT FOR THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN 6 AND 6S. COST AWARD REDUCED TO REFLECT EXCESSIVE COST OF SERVICE. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
